transcription_conventions.coverage: All numerical cells in Tables 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6; blank regression cells explicitly represented. Table 2 contains design definitions, recorded in manifest. Prose coverage includes empirical results and source/sample counts, excludes bibliographic years, historical dates and anecdotal distances unrelated to study results.
transcription_conventions.p_values: exact_p stores a printed numeric p-value only; all table p-values are rounded. Parentheses are retained in value_as_printed. p=0.00 is a rounding bin. No standard errors are published.
transcription_conventions.verification: All table and equation transcriptions checked against supplied page images. Initial OCR scrambling resolved; ocr_uncertain is false for legible verified entries.
transcription_conventions.numeric_strings: Unicode minus denotes the printed minus glyph; signed zero and trailing decimal precision retained. Percent values are in percent units, not probabilities.
